items.question: Is there a parent portal?
items.answer: No. Abyssinia Academy’s school management portals are Admin, Teacher, and Student only.

items.question: Does the public website stay bilingual?
items.answer: Yes. The public site supports English, Amharic, and Afaan Oromoo. Portal interfaces may expand languages over time.

items.question: Can teachers see all students?

items.question: Is school data secured?

items.question: Does this replace the public website?

hero.title: About Abyssinia Academy
hero.subtitle: Secondary Institution ({{grades}})
hero.tagline: Cultivating intellectual rigor, cultural heritage, and ethical leadership in the heart of Addis Ababa.
hero.paragraph1: Abyssinia Academy is an independent Ethiopian secondary institution ({{grades}}) founded on the conviction that high-level scholarship must remain inseparable from ethical character and national duty. Situated in Addis Ababa, the Academy prepares scholars through a demanding curriculum that pairs rigorous natural sciences and mathematics with humane inquiry in literature, history, and civic ethics.
hero.paragraph2: We reject educational short-cuts and rote compliance. Our scholars are taught to read deliberately, challenge conclusions methodically, articulate viewpoints in both Amharic and English, and honor the historical legacy of our homeland while preparing for university study.

story.title: Our Story & Academic Heritage
story.paragraph1: The foundation of Abyssinia Academy emerged from a conviction shared by Ethiopian educators: that Addis Ababa required a dedicated secondary institution committed to the intellectual and ethical maturation of adolescents in Grades 9 through 12.
story.paragraph2: The Academy focuses on core secondary instruction, disciplined study commons, laboratory practices, and an attentive educator-to-student mentor environment.

howToApply.p1: Admissions are open for {{grades}}. We review every applicant carefully — academic records, character, and readiness to join our learning community — rather than using a single formula.
howToApply.p2: Share your details through the inquiry form below. Our Admissions Office will guide you through assessment dates, required documents, and enrollment steps.

faqLeft.question: What does submitting an inquiry mean, and what's next?
faqLeft.answer: An inquiry tells our office you are interested. We will contact you with the next steps for assessment, documentation, and enrollment for Grades 9–12.

faqLeft.question: I missed a reply deadline. Can I still continue?
faqLeft.answer: Contact the Admissions Office as soon as possible. Late replies are reviewed case by case when capacity remains.

faqLeft.question: Can I appeal or reapply?
faqLeft.answer: Yes. You may request guidance on appeals or reapplication windows from Admissions after a decision is issued.

faqRight.question: My status is unqualified. What does that mean?
faqRight.answer: It usually means required criteria or documents were not met for this cycle. Admissions can explain options for the next intake.

faqRight.question: If my status is qualified, am I accepted?
faqRight.answer: Qualified means you meet academic criteria. Final acceptance depends on placement capacity, interview (if required), and completed enrollment steps.

faqRight.question: I submitted documents late. What should I do?
faqRight.answer: Email or visit Admissions with your reference details. We will confirm whether your file can be restored or resubmitted.
